title.narrative: Strengthening the production of vaccines and pharmaceuticals in Senegal

description.narrative: The Government of Senegal launched the Emergent Senegal Plan (#Plan Senegal Emergent## - PSE) and its associated Priority Action Plan (PAP), to transform Senegal into an emerging economy by 2035. The aspiration of the PSE is to support local pharmaceutical companies, enhance the promotion of local made pharmaceutical products, foster partnerships for local companies to support their growth and development, and ensure adherence to WHO Good Manufacturing Practices. Specifically, PSE, through the support of the DU aspires to produce 50% of the pharmaceuticals consumed in the country by 2035. The Senegalese pharmaceutical market is estimated at $ 400 million, with a reputed 95% of the drugs utilized in the country being imported. The market has been growing at circa 12% annually, and heavily dominated by Indian generic companies and European multinationals. The country has five to six pharmaceutical companies, only two of which are reputed to be engaged only in some form of pharmaceutical production, although uncompetitive and with limited portfolios, whilst the other three are said to be engaged only in packaging of imported finished bulk.
